text:
Working on more choreography in scenes of fighting or action. The prompt adherence and clarity are just insane. Not to mention that apparently Seedance 2.1 comes out somewhat soon. That's suppose to be a slight improvement to what is already a very well done model.

The future is pretty exciting for gen AI isn't it?
content: Use 3 reference images to assemble a choreography/fighting/action scene in Seedance.
